# fjoin <img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="138" alt="" />
Data frame joins backed by `r pkg("data.table")`

## Installation

Latest version from GitHub :
```r
remotes::install_github("trobx/fjoin")
```
## More information

See [Get started](https://trobx.github.io/fjoin/articles/fjoin.html).
